status: Editable planning assumptions; not a service quotation
cost_scope: Library preparation, QC, sequencing consumables, allocated instrument time, analysis compute, storage and contingency. Extraction, shipping, tax, VAT, personnel hiring and institutional overhead are excluded.

illumina.label: Illumina short reads
illumina.error_mode: Substitution errors, sequence-dependent GC/PCR bias; repeats and paralogs create ambiguous short-read alignments.
illumina.capability_note: The 25B envelope applies to this selected configuration. Small projects require pooling or a different instrument; a whole flow cell has a large minimum cost.
illumina.cost_provenance: Reagent-only $2/Gb benchmark comes from $200 per 100-Gb genome; $16,000/run is derived at 8,000 Gb. Shared $5/Gb, prep, instrument and compute amounts are project assumptions.

pacbio.label: PacBio HiFi
pacbio.error_mode: Consensus reduces single-pass errors; residual errors, allelic bias, DNA quality and hard regions still matter.
pacbio.capability_note: Yield assumes high-quality 15–20 kb DNA. RNA/isoform library yields do not follow the DNA envelope; RNA cost output is an exploratory allocation.
pacbio.cost_provenance: 2026 SPRQ-Nx reagent-only $345 at 20× human coverage gives $5.75/Gb using a 3-Gb haploid genome; $690 is derived for 120 Gb. Shared $12/Gb and all non-reagent costs are assumptions, not quotes.

nanopore.label: Oxford Nanopore
nanopore.instrument: MinION / GridION, one DNA flow cell
nanopore.read_length: 25 kb DNA planning target; distribution depends on extraction
nanopore.error_mode: Basecaller/chemistry-dependent substitutions and indels, with systematic context and homopolymer errors; simplex and duplex are distinct.
nanopore.capability_note: 15–35 Gb is the published typical DNA output. The 25-kb and 100-kb read-length targets and 72-hour schedule are assumptions. Do not apply this DNA yield to direct RNA.
nanopore.cost_provenance: Single FLO-MIN114 DNA flow cell costs US$840 in the official U.S. store on 2026-10-06. $33.60/Gb is derived at the assumed 25-Gb yield. Preparation, device allocation, analysis and taxes are additional.

sources.title: Illumina NovaSeq X Series specification sheet
sources.supports: Single 25B flow cell at 2×150 bp: approximately 8–10.5 Tb; 48-hour run.

sources.title: Illumina: broader and deeper sequencing
sources.supports: $200 per genome at list price on 25B, assuming 100 Gb/genome; sequencing consumables only.

sources.title: PacBio Revio DNA library technical overview
sources.supports: 15–20 kb DNA libraries: 100–120 Gb per SMRT Cell in 24 hours, under recommended preparation conditions.

sources.title: PacBio Revio / SPRQ-Nx
sources.supports: Approximately $345 at 20× human coverage in 2026 U.S. reagent list pricing. Prep, instrument, labor and compute excluded.

sources.title: Oxford Nanopore devices and flow cells
sources.supports: MinION Mk1D typical DNA output 15–35 Gb; native DNA/RNA and variable read lengths.

sources.title: Oxford Nanopore storage guidance
sources.supports: POD5 approximately 4–7 GB per sequenced Gbase; compressed FASTQ approximately 0.65 GB and aligned BAM approximately 1.4 GB at approximately 20-kb N50.

sources.title: AWS S3 pricing
sources.supports: Storage depends on region, class, retention and requests. $0.023/GB-month here is an illustrative U.S. Standard assumption; verify the applicable region.

sources.title: AWS EC2 On-Demand pricing
sources.supports: Compute is metered by instance duration. The advisor's $0.35/instance-hour is an editable budget assumption, not an EC2 quote.

sources.title: Oxford Nanopore U.S. flow-cell store
sources.supports: Single FLO-MIN114 DNA flow cell US$840 on 2026-10-06; preparation, device, tax and labor excluded.

sources.title: Northwestern NUSeq FY26 external service prices
sources.supports: Independent U.S. external academic rates. NovaSeq X Plus 10B PE150 lane: $1,873.75 for 1.0–1.2 billion pairs; 25B PE150 lane: $3,750 for 2.5–3.0 billion pairs. DNA prep <24 samples: $240; stranded mRNA prep <96: $198; ONT prep: $437.50. Service rates differ from reagent prices.

validation_benchmarks.scope: Arithmetic consistency check against vendor reagent-only benchmark; not independent or end-to-end validation.
Arithmetic conversion using 3-Gb genome × 20; not independent or end-to-end validation.

validation_benchmarks.name: NUSeq 10B PE150 external academic lane
validation_benchmarks.scope: Service price includes sequencing and instrument operation. Compare with model sequencing + instrument, excluding preparation/QC/compute/storage/contingency. Different flow-cell configuration (10B vs configured 25B) limits direct equivalence; minimum billable unit is a whole lane.

validation_benchmarks.name: NUSeq 25B PE150 external academic lane
validation_benchmarks.scope: Independent external service benchmark for the same 25B PE150 configuration. Service sequencing includes instrument operation, so do not add instrument cost to the published service price. A full lane is the minimum published unit; shared allocation remains an assumption.

validation_benchmarks.name: NUSeq DNA library prep <24 samples
validation_benchmarks.scope: Preparation service alone. Project assumption excludes service labor/overhead; a mismatch is expected and should constrain interpretation of the project total.

validation_benchmarks.name: NUSeq stranded mRNA prep <96 samples
validation_benchmarks.scope: Library preparation alone, without sequencing. Not applicable to all RNA library strategies.

validation_benchmarks.name: NUSeq Nanopore long-read library prep
validation_benchmarks.scope: External academic preparation service. The project preparation assumption omits the service's labor and overhead.
